$comment: Contract for data/tables/plausibility_windows.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js.
title: Plausibility windows
description: One row per property and class of material: the range a published value can credibly fall in. Outside the hard bounds a value is impossible and is refused as it is read; outside the soft bounds it is surprising and a person looks at it. These windows judge an observation on its way in. They are not the estimate model's bounds, which judge a prediction on its way out (build/mappings/estimate-model.json) and are deliberately looser.

fields.name: Normalized unit
fields.description: The unit the bounds are in, which must be one the property is kept in. A property measured on several scales (a hardness) needs a window per scale, because the scales are incommensurable.

fields.name: Matrix class
fields.description: What the material is made of, coarsely: its morphology, or high-temp for the polymers the estimate model does not identify. `any` matches everything and is the fallback.

fields.name: Fill class
fields.description: How the filler acts on this property: unfilled, fibre, dense, light, or any. `dense` is a particle load a maker declares but does not name (D57, R078): metal or mineral powder, which raises density far more than stiffness. `light` is a foaming agent or a declared lightweight additive, whose density and stiffness both fall with how much the printer foams it. A compound whose maker discloses nothing at all reads as `any`, so it is flagged rather than refused (D80).

fields.name: Condition
fields.description: A test condition that changes the credible range by more than the class does. Only the notch does, and by an order of magnitude.

fields.name: Hard low
fields.description: Below this the value is impossible for this class and is refused as it is read. Not applicable means unbounded below.

fields.name: Soft low
fields.description: Below this the value is surprising and a person looks at it.

fields.name: Soft high
fields.description: Above this the value is surprising and a person looks at it.

fields.name: Hard high
fields.description: Above this the value is impossible for this class and is refused as it is read. Not applicable means unbounded above.

fields.name: Always flag
fields.description: TRUE where the existence of the value is the finding, whatever its number: an elastomer's heat deflection temperature, or a hardness with no scale. No bound can express that.

fields.name: Basis
fields.description: Where the bounds came from, saying which are physics and which are what this database holds. A window with no basis is a number nobody can argue with.
